mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Purposing or wishing to worship.
E.
यज to worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Desirous of sacrificing.
E.
यज to worship, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-षा)
Wish to mix, blend, &c.
E.
यु to mix, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to mix or blend.
E.
यु to mix, desid. v., उ aff.
